head: codex/5826-birthday-identity
title: [v0.92][WP-09] Stable name and identity architecture
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5826

## Summary
- add deterministic stable-name and identity-root derivation with canonical retained records
- bind origin provenance and continuity references while rejecting collisions, substitutions, private state, unsafe paths, and unknown fields
- add the narrow WP-09 exact-head native macOS/Linux receipt workflow and independent exact-run validator

## Validation
- exact `birthday_identity` nextest target: 7/7 passed
- strict Clippy and formatting: passed
- Ruby producer/validator syntax and fail-closed non-GitHub probe: passed
- typed C-SDLC validation and independent exact-head review: passed
- native macOS/Linux receipt execution: required from this PR's issue-specific workflow before readiness

## Review
Independent exact-head review approved the bounded product, workflow, proof, and lifecycle scope with no actionable findings. This PR does not claim downstream continuity or Birthday completion.
